The rule

A subscription started online can be cancelled online, and cancelling takes no more steps than signing up did (one extra confirmation is allowed). No phone calls, no dead ends.

Why it matters
  • California Bus. & Prof. Code §17602 (AB 2863, from 1 July 2025): an online subscription must offer online cancellation, as easy as signing up
  • German Civil Code (BGB) §312k: consumer contracts sold online need a clearly labelled cancellation button
  • EU Directive 2023/2673, Art. 11a (from 19 June 2026): withdrawing from an online contract must be possible online and no more burdensome than concluding it
